title: Tenma Saki — The Yummiest Drink!〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (A brother and sister living apart... But they're so close...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (They really seemed to enjoy seeing our shows too...)

rows.Speaker: Yota
rows.Line: She won't be able to get along with her new family as long as her old one's around... Including me...

rows.Speaker: Yota
rows.Line: In terms of what's best for her future, I feel like she needs to learn to get along with her new family.

rows.Speaker: Yota
rows.Line:
Which is why...
Today, I said, “We need to stop meeting like this.”

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (It's so tough, but he wants what's best for her.)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (If Tsukasa said something like that to me after we had to start living apart like them...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: You don't usually get home until way later. Did you guys not have practice today or something?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
No, we did.
It just happened to go better than expected!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: We took this opportunity to call it early and give ourselves some well-deserved rest.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Also! We're having curry for dinner tonight! It should be ready in just a bit too!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
We both love curry, right?
It's sweet, savory and full of meat, carrots and potatoes! With plenty of those pickles you like too!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Still, I know this is another family's business, but siblings having to live apart like that sounds so...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: If I were in their shoes, I'd feel absolutely terrible...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I mean, Tsukasa, without you, I probably wouldn't have been able to deal with all the treatment I had to receive at the hospital...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Is not seeing each other really the answer...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Every family's different.
What's best for them or what will make them happy will vary based on their individual situations.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I know it must be painful... But the brother arrived upon this after thinking long and hard about their conundrum, no?

rows.Speaker: Hanano
rows.Line: Ugh... I'm done talking to you!!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: It's hard enough not getting to see each other as it is, but they left things off by having a big fight...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Even after they said that they're our fans...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Isn't there anything we can do for them...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Don't get yourself down like that...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: If you genuinely wish to do something for them, you should start by lifting your chin and looking forward.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Because there's no way you'll ever come up with a good solution while in such a somber mood!
